abstractContent.text: Write the abstract as a single, continuous paragraph without subheadings. Begin with a brief introduction to the research topic, establishing its scientific relevance and identifying the research problem or existing knowledge gap. Clearly state the objective of the study, followed by a concise description of the materials, methodology, experimental approaches, or analytical techniques employed. Present the major findings, highlighting significant results, novel observations, and the contribution of the research. Conclude by emphasizing the scientific significance, practical implications, potential applications, and future relevance of the findings. The abstract should be scientifically accurate, coherent, concise, and written in formal academic English.
